units.en: In Putong 1 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and Sha, and Yi province inspector;
units.literal: In year 1 of Putong he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, and Sha, and made Yi Province Inspector;

units.zh: 三年四月乙巳，昭明太子薨。
units.en: On yisi in the fourth month of year 3 Crown Prince Zhaoming died.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day yisi, year 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming died.

units.zh: 大寶元年春正月辛亥朔，以國哀不朝會。
units.en: On xinhai, the new-year's day of Dabao 1, national mourning prevented the court assembly.
units.literal: On xinhai, the first day of the first month of spring in year 1 of Dabao, because of national mourning there was no court assembly.

units.zh: 可大赦天下，改太清四年為大寶元年。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed and Taiqing 4 is changed to Dabao 1."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed; Taiqing year 4 is changed to Dabao year 1."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不造，夙丁閔凶。
units.en: An edict said, "Ill-fated as I am, I have long borne this grief.
units.literal: An edict said: "Our lack of fortune afflicts us; from early we suffered this calamity.

units.zh: 大行皇帝奄棄萬國，攀慕號躃，厝身靡所。
units.en: The late emperor has suddenly left the myriad realms; in longing and wailing I have nowhere to set myself.
units.literal: The late emperor suddenly abandoned the myriad realms; we cling and wail and have nowhere to place ourselves.

units.zh: 猥以寡德，越居民上，煢煢在疚，罔知所託，方賴籓輔，社稷用安。
units.en: With slight virtue I have undeservedly risen above the people; alone in grief I know not whom to trust, and must rely on the feudatories to keep the altars secure.
units.literal: Unworthily with slight virtue we have crossed above the people; alone in anguish we know not where to lean, yet rely on the feudal helpers that the altars may be secure.

units.zh: 謹遵先旨，顧命遺澤，宜加億兆。
units.en: Respectfully following the prior command and the grace of the deathbed charge, the hundred millions should receive added benefit.
units.literal: Respectfully following the prior will and the bequeathed grace of the final charge, benefit should be added for the hundred millions.

units.zh: 可大赦天下。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed for the empire."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed for the empire."

units.zh: 詔曰：「蓋天下者，至公之神器，在昔三五，不獲已而臨蒞之。
units.en: An edict said, "All under Heaven is the sacred vessel of utmost fairness; in antiquity the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors took the throne only when they could not refuse.
units.literal: An edict said: "All under Heaven is the sacred vessel of utmost fairness; in ages past the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors took the throne only because they had no choice.

units.zh: 故帝王之功，聖人之餘事。
units.en: Thus the work of emperors and kings is what sages leave as surplus.
units.literal: Thus the achievement of emperors and kings is what sages leave over.

units.zh: 軒冕之華，儻來之一物。
units.en: Chariot and cap are adornments that come by chance alone.
units.literal: The glory of chariot and cap is something that came by chance.

units.zh: 太祖文皇帝含光大之量，啓西伯之基。
units.en: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor held vast hidden brilliance and laid the foundation of the Western Earl.
units.literal: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor embraced a great measure of hidden light and opened the foundation of the Western Earl.

units.zh: 高祖武皇帝道洽二儀，智周萬物。
units.en: Gaozu the Martial Emperor made the Way fill the two principles and his wisdom encompass the myriad things.
units.literal: The Martial Emperor, the Gaozu, made the Way pervade the two principles and wisdom compass the myriad things.

units.zh: 屬齊季薦瘥，彝倫剝喪，同氣離入苑之禍，元首懷無厭之欲，乃當樂推之運，因億兆之心，承彼掎角，雪茲讎恥。
units.en: When Qi neared its end pestilence returned and moral order collapsed, kin suffered the calamity of the park, and the ruler nursed insatiable desires—then came the fortune of willing elevation, the hearts of the hundred millions were followed, their allied strength was taken up, and this shame was avenged.
units.literal: When the late Qi era brought repeated pestilence and constant norms were stripped away, flesh-and-blood kin suffered the calamity of entering the park, and the ruler harbored insatiable desire—then we met the fortune of the people's willing elevation, drew on the hearts of the hundred millions, received their allied support, and avenged this shame.

units.zh: 事非為己，義寔從民。
units.en: The deed was not for oneself; in righteousness one truly followed the people.
units.literal: The affair was not for oneself; in righteousness one truly followed the people.

units.zh: 故功成弗居，卑宮菲食，大慈之業普薰，汾陽之詔屢下。
units.en: Therefore when the work was done he did not keep it, dwelt in low halls and ate plain food, great compassion spread widely, and edicts like those of Fenyang were issued again and again.
units.literal: Therefore when achievement was done he did not dwell on it, lived in low halls and plain food, the great compassionate enterprise broadly perfumed, and edicts like those of Fenyang were repeatedly issued.

units.zh: 于茲四紀，無得而稱。
units.en: For four reign cycles there has been no fully fitting praise.
units.literal: For four reign cycles now, none can fully praise it.

units.zh: 朕以寡昧，哀煢孔棘，生靈已盡，志不圖全，僶俛視陰，企承鴻緒。
units.en: I, slight and dull, am in deepest grief and distress; the living are exhausted and my will does not aim at wholeness; bowing low I await shade and hope to inherit the great succession.
units.literal: We, slight and dull, in deepest grief and distress—the living souls are spent and our will does not plan for wholeness; we bend low and look to shade, hoping to inherit the great thread.

units.zh: 懸旌履薄，未足云喻。
units.en: Banners hang over thin ice—words can scarcely tell it.
units.literal: Suspended banners over thin ice—words barely suffice.

units.zh: 痛甚愈遲，諒闇彌切。
units.en: Pain deepens as recovery is slow; mourning seclusion grows keener still.
units.literal: Pain grows deeper as healing delays; the period of hidden mourning is all the keener.

units.zh: 方當玄默在躬，栖心事外。
units.en: I should keep dark silence within and lodge my mind outside affairs.
units.literal: We should keep dark silence within and lodge the mind in matters beyond.

units.zh: 卽王道未直，天步猶艱，式憑宰輔，以弘庶政。
units.en: Yet the kingly Way is not yet straight and the heavenly steps still hard; I must rely on chief ministers to broaden the myriad affairs of state.
units.literal: Yet the kingly Way is not yet straight and the heavenly course still hard—we must rely on chief ministers to expand the myriad administrations.

units.zh: 履端建號，仰惟舊章。
units.en: At the year's beginning I establish the era name, looking up to the old statutes.
units.literal: Observing the year's beginning, we establish the era name, looking up to the old statutes.

units.zh: 冬十月壬寅，帝謂舍人殷不害曰：「吾昨夜夢吞土，卿試為我思之。」
units.en: On renyin in the tenth month of winter the emperor said to attendant Yin Buhai, "Last night I dreamed I swallowed earth—please interpret it for me."
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day renyin, the Emperor said to Attendant Yin Buhai: "Last night I dreamed I swallowed earth—try to interpret it for me."

units.zh: 帝笑曰：「壽酒，不得盡此乎？」
units.en: The emperor smiled and said, "Longevity wine—must it not be drunk to the dregs?"
units.literal: The Emperor smiled and said: "Longevity wine—must it not be drunk to the end?"

units.zh: 帝知不免，乃盡酣，曰：「不圖為樂一至於斯！」
units.en: Knowing he could not escape, the emperor drank his fill and said, "I never thought merriment could come to this!"
units.literal: Knowing he could not escape, the Emperor drank his fill and said: "I never thought pleasure could reach this point!"

units.zh: 弗欺暗室，豈況三光，數至於此，命也如何！」
units.en: I would not deceive a dark room—how much less the sun, moon, and stars; to come to this count is fate—what can be done!"
units.literal: I would not deceive a dark room—how much less the three luminaries; to reach this number is fate—what can be done!"

units.zh: 又為《連珠》二首，文甚悽愴。
units.en: He also wrote two "Linked Pearls" pieces, their tone deeply mournful.
units.literal: He also composed two Linked Pearls pieces, the text deeply mournful.

units.zh: 在襄陽拜表北伐，遣長史柳津、司馬董當門，壯武將軍杜懷寶、振遠將軍曹義宗等衆軍進討，剋平南陽、新野等郡，魏南荊州刺史李志據安昌城降，拓地千餘里。
units.en: At Xiangyang he memorialized for a northern campaign and sent chief clerk Liu Jin, marshal Dong Dangmen, martial valor general Du Huaibao, far-shaking general Cao Yizong, and others with the armies; they took Nanyang, Xinye, and other commanderies, Wei's south Jingzhou inspector Li Zhi surrendered Anchang fortress, and territory expanded more than a thousand li.
units.literal: At Xiangyang he memorialized for a northern campaign; he sent Chief Clerk Liu Jin, Marshal Dong Dangmen, Martial Valor General Du Huaibao, Far-Shaking General Cao Yizong, and others with the massed armies on expedition, conquering Nanyang, Xinye, and other commanderies; Wei's South Jingzhou Inspector Li Zhi, holding Anchang fortress, surrendered, and territory was extended more than a thousand li.

units.zh: 方頰豊下，須鬢如畫，眄睞則目光燭人。
units.en: Square of cheek and full below, beard and temples like painted lines; a sidelong glance lit upon men like fire.
units.literal: Square of cheek and full below, his beard and temples like a painting; when he glanced sidelong his gaze lit upon men.

units.zh: 篇章辭賦，操筆立成。
units.en: in essays, rhapsodies, and verse he took up the brush and finished on the spot.
units.literal: in essays, rhapsodies, and verse he took up the brush and finished at once.

units.zh: 於是並賚酒肴、曲項琵琶，與帝飲。
units.en: They then gave wine and food, a curved-neck pipa, and drank with him.
units.literal: Thereupon they all bestowed wine and food, a curved-neck pipa, and drank with the Emperor.

units.zh: 四月乙丑，葬莊陵。
units.en: On yichou in the fourth month he was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.
units.literal: Fourth month, day yichou, he was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.

units.zh: 太宗幼而敏睿，識悟過人，六歲便屬文，高祖驚其早就，弗之信也。
units.en: Taizong from childhood was quick and perceptive, his insight beyond others; at six he could write, and Gaozu marveled at his early gift but did not believe it.
units.literal: Taizong from youth was keen and perceptive, his understanding surpassing others; at six he could compose texts, and Gaozu marveled at his early maturity but did not believe it.

units.zh: 簡文帝
units.en: Emperor Jianwen
units.literal: Emperor Jianwen

units.zh: 丙午，侯景逼太宗幸西州。
units.en: On bingwu Hou Jing forced Taizong to go to Xizhou.
units.literal: On bingwu Hou Jing compelled the Taizong to visit Xizhou.

units.zh: 冬十月乙未，侯景又逼太宗幸西州曲宴，自加宇宙大將軍、都督六合諸軍事。
units.en: On yiwei in the tenth month of winter Hou Jing again forced Taizong to a banquet at Xizhou and made himself Grand General of the Cosmos and commander of the Six Harmonized Directions.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day yiwei, Hou Jing again compelled the Taizong to attend a banquet at Xizhou, and himself added Grand General of the Cosmos and Commander over military affairs in the Six Harmonized Directions.

units.zh: 矯為太宗詔，禪于豫章嗣王棟，大赦改年。
units.en: He forged an abdication edict in Taizong's name to the successor prince of Yuzhang, Dong, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
units.literal: Forging an edict in Taizong's name, he abdicated to the Successor Prince of Yuzhang, Dong; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

units.zh: 及王偉等進觴於帝曰：「丞相以陛下憂憤旣久，使臣上壽。」
units.en: Then Wang Wei and the others came forward with a toast and said, "The chancellor, seeing Your Majesty's long grief, has sent us to offer longevity wine."
units.literal: When Wang Wei and the others came forward with a toast to the Emperor, they said: "The Chancellor, seeing Your Majesty's long grief and distress, has sent us to offer longevity wine."

units.zh: 裴昭明，河東聞喜人，宋太中大夫松之孫也。
units.en: Pei Zhaoming was a native of Wenxi in Hedong commandery and a grandson of the Song dynasty grandee of palace attendants Pei Songzhi.
units.literal: Pei Zhaoming was a man of Wenxi in Hedong, grandson of Song Grandee of Palace Attendants Pei Songzhi.

units.zh: 丙子，執刺史蕭方諸。
units.en: On bingzi day they seized inspector Xiao Fangzhu.
units.literal: On bingzi, they seized Inspector Xiao Fangzhu.

units.zh: 琳故吏梁驃騎府倉曹參軍朱瑒致書陳尚書僕射徐陵求琳首曰：
units.en: Zhu Yang, a former clerk of Lin's in the Liang Cavalry-General's Office, wrote to Xu Ling, vice director of the Chen secretariat, begging for Lin's head. He said:
units.literal: Lin's former clerk Zhu Yang, warehouse aide of the Liang Cavalry-General's Office, wrote to Chen Secretariat Vice Director Xu Ling asking for Lin's head, saying:

units.zh: 太子曰：「顏子縮屋稱貞，柳下嫗而不亂，未若此翁白首不娶者也。」
units.en: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui was praised for chastity though he lived in a hovel, and Liu Xiahui kept his integrity though he shared a blanket with a woman—but neither can match this old man who has never married even to white hair."
units.literal: The crown prince said, "Yan Hui, who shrank in his hut, was called chaste; Liu Xiahui, who shared a blanket with a woman, was not corrupted—yet neither equals this old man, white-haired and never married."

units.zh: 時民近戰國，皆背本趨末，賈誼說上曰：筦子曰「倉廩實而知禮節」。
units.en: At the time popular life resembled the Warring States era, with everyone abandoning farming for marginal trades. Jia Yi urged the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."
units.literal: At the time the people were close to Warring States conditions, all turning from the fundamental to the marginal. Jia Yi persuaded the emperor, saying: Guanzi says, "When granaries are full, the people know ritual propriety."

units.zh: 於是上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓。
units.en: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened imperial fields and personally plowed to encourage the people.

units.zh: 漢之為漢幾四十年矣，公私之積猶可哀痛。
units.en: Even after decades, both state and household reserves remained fragile.
units.literal: Han has been Han nearly forty years, yet public and private accumulations are still pitiably painful.

units.zh: 民不足而可治者，自古及今，未之嘗聞。
units.en: No regime has stably governed a population in chronic deprivation.
units.literal: That people lacking means can still be governed-from ancient to present, this has never been heard.

units.zh: 古之人曰：「一夫不耕，或受之飢；
units.en: The ancients said, 'If one man does not farm, someone will go hungry;
units.literal: Ancients said: 'If one man does not farm, someone suffers hunger;

units.zh: 一女不織，或受之寒。」
units.en: if one woman does not weave, someone will suffer cold.'
units.literal: if one woman does not weave, someone suffers cold.'

units.zh: 生之有時，而用之亡度，則物力必屈。
units.en: If consumption outruns seasonal production, the economy inevitably buckles.
units.literal: Production has its timing, but use has no measure-then productive force must collapse.

units.zh: 古之治天下，至孅至悉也，故其畜積足恃。
units.en: Classical states built high-resolution management, which is why reserves were dependable.
units.literal: Ancient governance of the realm was meticulous to the finest degree; therefore their stores were sufficient to rely on.

units.zh: 今背本而趨末，食者甚眾，是天下之大殘也；
units.en: When society abandons productive fundamentals for secondary pursuits, macroeconomic damage follows.
units.literal: Now people turn away from root and rush to branch, while consumers are many-this is the realm's great injury;

units.zh: 淫侈之俗，日日以長，是天下之大賊也。
units.en: Escalating luxury culture is treated as parasitic extraction from real production.
units.literal: and luxurious, extravagant custom grows daily-this is the realm's great thief.

units.zh: 殘賊公行，莫之或止；
units.en: Predatory behavior has become normalized and unchecked;
units.literal: Injury and theft run openly, with none to stop them;

units.zh: 大命將泛，莫之振救。
units.en: political legitimacy itself is nearing systemic failure.
units.literal: the great mandate is about to drift, with none to rescue and stabilize it.

units.zh: 生之者甚少而靡之者甚多，天下財產何得不蹶！
units.en: A widening producer-consumer imbalance makes fiscal collapse unavoidable.
units.literal: Those who produce are very few while those who consume are very many-how can the realm's wealth not collapse!

units.zh: 失時不雨，民且狼顧；
units.en: Any weather shock immediately triggers social anxiety and scarcity behavior;
units.literal: If seasonal rain fails, people already look about like wolves;

units.zh: 歲惡不入，請賣爵、子。
units.en: In severe scarcity, people seek desperate liquidity-including status sales and family liquidation.
units.literal: if bad harvest yields no intake, they request selling ranks and even children.

units.zh: 既聞耳矣，安有為天下阽危者若是而上不驚者！
units.en: Given such warning signs, elite complacency is inexcusable.
units.literal: We have already heard this-how can the realm be in such peril and those above not be alarmed!

units.zh: 世之有飢穰，天之行也，禹、湯被之矣。
units.en: Famine and abundance are Heaven's recurrent course; Yu and Tang experienced them too.
units.literal: Ages have famine and abundance-this is Heaven's operation; Yu and Tang experienced it too.

units.zh: 即不幸有方二三千里之旱，國胡以相恤？
units.en: Large-scale drought requires coordinated interregional relief capacity.
units.literal: If by misfortune there is drought over two or three thousand li, how can the state mutually relieve it?

units.zh: 卒然邊境有急，數十百萬之眾，國胡以餽之？
units.en: Likewise, emergency mobilization needs strategic grain depth.
units.literal: If suddenly borders are urgent and crowds of hundreds of thousands arise, how can the state provision them?

units.zh: 兵旱相乘，天下大屈，有勇力者聚徒而衡擊，罷夫羸老易子而沦其骨。
units.en: Compound shocks of war plus famine produce social violence and extreme famine behaviors.
units.literal: When war and drought strike together, the world greatly bends: those with strength gather bands and attack; exhausted elders exchange children and gnaw their bones.

units.zh: 政治未畢通也，遠方之能疑者並舉而爭起矣，乃駭而圖之，豈將有及乎？
units.en: Without integrated governance beforehand, crisis response comes too late.
units.literal: If governance has not yet been fully connected, distant powers still able to doubt will all rise and contend; then to panic and plan, how could there be time?

units.zh: 夫積貯者，天下之大命也。
units.en: Strategic reserves are the state's core survival mechanism.
units.literal: Accumulated storage is the great lifeline of the realm.

units.zh: 苟粟多而財有餘，何為而不成？
units.en: With deep reserves, nearly all strategic aims become feasible.
units.literal: If grain is abundant and wealth in surplus, what objective cannot be accomplished?

units.zh: 以攻則取，以守則固，以戰則勝。
units.en: Reserves convert directly into offensive, defensive, and battlefield advantage.
units.literal: To attack, one takes; to defend, one is firm; to fight, one wins.

units.zh: 懷敵附遠，何招而不至？
units.en: Material strength also enhances diplomacy and long-distance attraction.
units.literal: Holding enemies and attaching distant peoples-what summons would not come?

units.zh: 今毆民而歸之農，皆著於本，使天下各食其力，末技游食之民轉而緣南畝，則畜積足而人樂其所矣。
units.en: Re-agrarianization and labor reallocation toward primary production would stabilize both reserves and social satisfaction.
units.literal: Now if we drive people back to agriculture, all fixed on the root, so everyone eats by labor and roaming eaters of secondary skills turn toward southern furrows, then stores suffice and people enjoy their place.

units.zh: 可以為富安天下，而直為此廩廩也，竊為陛下惜之！
units.en: The policy path to security is available, making current anxiety feel self-inflicted.
units.literal: This could enrich and secure the realm, yet we only remain trembling in fear-I secretly regret this for Your Majesty.

units.zh: 為僕射時，語人曰：「我在江東，見徐勉作僕射，朝士莫不佞之。
units.en: When he was vice director he told people, "In the southeast I saw Xu Mian serve as vice director, and no court gentleman failed to flatter him.
units.literal: When he was vice director he said to people, "In the southeast I saw Xu Mian serve as vice director, and no court gentleman failed to flatter him.

units.zh: 賾與河南元善、河東柳䛒、太原王劭、吳興姚察、琅琊諸葛潁、信都劉焯、河間劉炫相善，每因休假，清談竟日。
units.en: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.
units.literal: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.

units.zh: 及司州城陷，爲御史中丞任昉所奏。
units.en: When Si province fell, Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang impeached him.
units.literal: When Si province's city fell, he was impeached by Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang.

units.zh: 譬若以周、邵為丞相，孔丘為御史大夫，太公為將軍，畢公高拾遺於後，弁嚴子為衛尉，皋陶為大理，後稷為司農，伊尹為少府，子贛使外國，顏、閔為博士，子夏為太常，益為右扶風，季路為執金吾，契為鴻臚，龍逢為宗正，伯夷為京兆，管仲為馮翊，魯般為將作，仲山甫為光祿，申伯為太僕，延陵季子為水衡，百里奚為典屬國，柳下惠為大長秋，史魚為司直，蘧伯玉為太傅，孔父為詹事，孫叔敖為諸侯相，子產為郡守，王慶忌為期門，夏育為鼎官，羿為旄頭，宋萬為式道候。」
units.en: Imagine the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao as your chancellors; Confucius as chief censor; the Grand Duke as commander; Duke Bi Gao as court remonstrant; Bian Zhuangzi as captain of the guard; Gao Yao as chief judge; Hou Ji as minister of agriculture; Yi Yin as palace treasurer; Zigong as foreign envoy; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian as court scholars; Zixia as master of rites; Yi as western capital intendant; Zilu as capital commandant; Xie as master of guest ceremonies; Guan Longpeng as keeper of the imperial genealogy; the minister Boyi as metropolitan governor; Guan Zhong as northern capital intendant; Lu Ban as chief engineer; Zhong Shanfu as palace chamberlain; the Earl of Shen as master of the horse; Prince Jizi of Yanling as keeper of parks and waters; Baili Xi as commissioner for dependent peoples; Liuxia Hui as chamberlain to the empress; Shi Yu as censor of conduct; Qu Boyu as grand tutor; Kong Fu as supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao as chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan as commandery governor; Prince Qingji as a palace gate guard; Xia Yu as cauldron officer; Yi the Archer as vanguard officer; and Song Wan as road-clearing scout."
units.literal: It is as if you had made the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao your chancellors; Confucius your Censor-in-Chief; the Grand Duke your general; Duke Bi Gao your remonstrant at the rear; Bian Zhuangzi your Commandant of the Guards; Gao Yao your Chief Justice; Hou Ji your Minister of Agriculture; Yi Yin your Privy Treasurer; Zigong your envoy abroad; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian your Erudites; Zixia your Minister of Ceremonies; Yi your western capital intendant; Zilu your Capital Commandant; Xie your Grand Herald; Guan Longpeng your Director of the Imperial Clan; the minister Boyi your Metropolitan Governor; Guan Zhong your northern capital intendant; Lu Ban your Superintendent of Works; Zhong Shanfu your Chamberlain for Attendants; the Earl of Shen your Grand Coachman; Prince Jizi of Yanling your Superintendent of Waters and Parks; Baili Xi your Director of Dependent States; Liuxia Hui your Chamberlain for the Empress; Shi Yu your Rectifier; Qu Boyu your Grand Tutor; Kong Fu your supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao your chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan your commandery governor; Prince Qingji your Palace Gate Guard; Xia Yu your Cauldron Officer; Yi the Archer your Vanguard Officer; and Song Wan your road-clearing scout."

units.zh: 祖愉，晉車騎將軍。
units.en: His grandfather Yu had served Jin as Cavalry General-in-Chief.
units.literal: His grandfather Yu had been Cavalry General-in-Chief under Jin.

units.zh: 父誾，散騎常侍。
units.en: His father Yin had been Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry.
units.literal: His father Yin had been Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry.

units.zh: 芳又私撰歷書，名為《靈憲歷》，算月有頻大頻小，食必以朔，證據甚甄明，每云：「何承天亦為此法，不能精，靈憲若成，必當百代無異議。」
units.en: His private Spiritual Constitution Calendar tracked the moon’s varying size and fixed eclipses at new moon with rare clarity. “He Chengtian tried this but lacked precision,” he said; “finish this calendar and posterity will not quarrel.”
units.literal: Fang also privately drafted a calendar called the Spiritual Constitution Calendar, calculating that the moon is sometimes large and sometimes small and that eclipses must fall on new moon; the evidence was very clear. He often said, “He Chengtian also used this method but could not refine it; if the Spiritual Constitution is completed, for a hundred generations there will be no dispute.”

units.zh: 父之遴，荊州治中從事史。
units.en: His father Zhi-lin was an aide in the secretariat of Jing province.
units.literal: His father Zhi-lin was Aide in the Secretariat of Jing province.

units.zh: 祖虯，齊世以國子博士徵，不就。
units.en: His grandfather Qiu, in Qi times, was summoned as erudite of the national university and declined.
units.literal: His grandfather Qiu in Qi times was summoned as Erudite of the National University and did not accept.

units.zh: 仲威從弟廣德，亦好學，負才任氣。
units.en: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and was confident in his talent and spirit.
units.literal: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and relied on his talent and spirit.

units.zh: 處士阮孝緒致書抑譬，霽思慕不已，服未終而卒，時年五十二。
units.en: Ruan Xiaoxu wrote to restrain him, but Ji's longing never ceased; before mourning ended he died at fifty-two.
units.literal: The recluse Ruan Xiaoxu sent a letter to restrain and comfort him, but Ji's longing did not cease; before mourning ended he died, aged fifty-two.

units.zh: 舅阮孝緒聞之，歎曰：「此兒在家則曾子之流，事君則藺生之匹。」
units.en: His uncle Ruan Xiaoxu sighed, "At home this boy is like Zengzi; in serving a lord he would match young Lan."
units.literal: His maternal uncle Ruan Xiaoxu heard of it and sighed, "This child at home is of Zengzi's sort; in serving his lord he would match the lad Lan."

units.zh: 孝緒每曰「吾家陽元也」。
units.en: Xiaoxu often said, "He is our house's Yangyuan."
units.literal: Xiaoxu often said, "He is the Yangyuan of our house."

units.zh: 及丁父憂，晝夜號慟，毀瘠骨立，母阮氏常自守視譬抑之。
units.en: After his father's death he wailed day and night until only bone remained; his mother Lady Ruan constantly watched and restrained him.
units.literal: When he entered mourning for his father he wailed day and night, wasted away until only bone stood, and his mother Lady Ruan constantly watched over him herself to restrain and comfort him.

units.zh: 王僧辯之討侯景也，王琳為前軍，琳與瑒同門，乃表薦為戎昭將軍、宜都太守，仍從僧辯救徐文盛於武昌。
units.en: When Wang Sengbian attacked Hou Jing, Wang Lin led the van. Lin and Yang were schoolmates; Lin recommended him as martial-announcements general and administrator of Yidu, and he followed Sengbian to relieve Xu Wensheng at Wuchang.
units.literal: When Wang Sengbian campaigned against Hou Jing, Wang Lin was vanguard; Lin and Yang were of the same gate, and Lin memorialized recommending him as Martial-Announcements General and Administrator of Yidu, and he followed Sengbian to rescue Xu Wensheng at Wuchang.

units.zh: 舅吳平光侯蕭勱〔一〕，名重當時，特所鍾愛，嘗謂總曰：「爾操行殊異，神采英拔，後之知名，當出吾右。」
units.en: His maternal uncle Xiao Mai, Marquis Guang of Wuping, [1] enjoyed a weighty reputation in his day and cherished Zong especially. He once told Zong, "Your conduct is wholly unlike that of others, and your spirit is striking and elevated; when you become famous hereafter, you will stand above me."
units.literal: His maternal uncle Xiao Mai, Marquis Guang of Wuping, enjoyed a weighty reputation in his day and cherished Zong especially. He once told Zong: "Your conduct is wholly unlike that of others, and your spirit is striking and elevated; when you become famous hereafter, you will stand above me."

units.zh: 〔一〕 舅吳平光侯蕭勱 「勱」梁書蕭景傳、南史吳平侯景傳並作「勵」，南史江總傳又作「勱」。
units.en: On "his maternal uncle Xiao Mai, Marquis Guang of Wuping": both the Book of Liang biography of Xiao Jing and the Southern History biography of Marquis Jing of Wuping write the final character of Mai's name as li; the Southern History biography of Jiang Zong again writes it as mai.
units.literal: [1] His maternal uncle Xiao Mai, Marquis Guang of Wuping: both the Book of Liang biography of Xiao Jing and the Southern History biography of Marquis Jing of Wuping write the final character of Mai's name as li; the Southern History biography of Jiang Zong again writes it as mai.

units.zh: 按桂馥說文解字義證云「勱」字或作「勵」。
units.en: Gui Fu's Evidential Explanation of the Meanings of the Shuowen Jiezi says that the final character of Mai's name may also be written with the graph read "li".
units.literal: According to Gui Fu's Evidential Explanation of the Meanings of the Shuowen Jiezi, the final character of Mai's name may also be written with the graph read "li".

units.zh: 解褐梁太學博士，稍遷西中郎湘東王外兵記室參軍，與東海鮑泉、南陽宗懍、平原劉緩、沛郡劉瑴同掌書記。
units.en: He entered office as a Liang grand-academy doctor, then rose to secretary on Prince Xiangdong's outer military staff, sharing record-keeping with Bao Quan of Donghai, Zong Lin of Nanyang, Liu Huan of Pingyuan, and Liu Yue of Pei.
units.literal: Upon leaving the sackcloth he was a Liang Grand Academy Doctor; he was gradually promoted to secretary in the outer military staff office of the Western Central Commander, Prince of Xiangdong, and together with Bao Quan of Donghai, Zong Lin of Nanyang, Liu Huan of Pingyuan, and Liu Yue of Pei commandery shared charge of secretarial records.

units.zh: 父之亨，梁安西湘東王長史、南郡太守。
units.en: His father Zhiheng was chief clerk to Liang's Prince of Xiangdong, general who secures the west, and administrator of Nanjun.
units.literal: His father Zhiheng was chief clerk to Liang's Prince of Xiangdong, general who secures the west, and administrator of Nanjun.
